content: We propose a recurrent generative model that sequentially generates multiple keyphrases, with two extra modules that enhance generation diversity. We propose new metrics to evaluate keyphrase generation. Our model shows competitive performance on a set of keyphrase generation datasets, including one introduced in this work. In future work, we plan to investigate how target phrase order affects the generation behavior, and further explore set generation in an order invariant fashion.
